featureGates.detail: Waitlist may collect interest via user-sent email. Free-shirt drawing entries must not open until official rules, dates and eligibility terms are published.

Vercel Web Analytics is optional. Current connector can read analytics but cannot enable the project-level feature.

The original approved portrait path was recovered from archived Benny site previews, but the standalone binary is not present in Library or repository storage. Artist hero uses a first-party release-art fallback until the original binary is recovered.
